summary: Equinor ASA furnished a Form 6-K containing its October 20, 2026 press release on the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme. The tranche, announced July 22, 2026, runs July 23 to no later than October 26, 2026. From October 12-16, 2026, Equinor repurchased 540,275 own shares at an average NOK 425.4849, totaling NOK 229,878,871.46, bringing accumulated tranche buy-backs to 8,238,107 shares at average NOK 398.4234 (NOK 3,282,254,732.19). Total treasury holdings reach 23,077,317 shares, or 0.97% of share capital. Watch execution pace and daily disclosure ahead of tranche completion.
